name: HRP-2 Promet
summary: The flagship robot of Japan's national Humanoid Robotics Project, developed by AIST with Kawada Industries and given an exterior by mecha designer Yutaka Izubuchi. HRP-2 could lie down and stand back up, walk on narrow paths and carry loads two-handed, and around a dozen units were sold to research groups, making it one of the first widely shared full-size humanoid platforms.
notable: Could fall, lie prone and get back up unaided
One of the first full-size humanoids sold to multiple labs
